# Doppel 2.1.0
Create separate Claude desktop apps from New Instance → Claude, each with its own login, Code configuration, name and colour. Google sign-in returns to the right instance, and Claude's pale star stays visible on tinted icons.
After signing in and opening Code, use Import Existing Code History to bring over local conversations for the same account and workspace. Existing sessions and original files are kept. Missing transcripts and working folders are reported. Working copies are not moved, so check the original folder for uncommitted work if Claude creates a new worktree when resuming a conversation.

# Doppel 2.0.5
- Doppel no longer keeps every ChatGPT update it has ever downloaded. After an update it keeps the newest download, the newest two rollback copies and only a prepared build that is still waiting to install. On one Mac these leftovers had grown to 31 GB. - The rollback copy for the ChatGPT build you are running is never removed, so rolling back still works. - QA builds and builds that fail or are interrupted no longer leave 1.7 GB app copies behind in their staging folders. - `doppel prune` with no name now tidies the updates folder too and includes it in the size it reports. Run it once after updating to clear what earlier versions left behind.

# Doppel 2.0.4
- New **Use with Claude Code** in the Creator Micro menu, and `doppel micro claude <channel>` on the command line. Doppel installs the codex-micro Claude Code plugin, turns on the setting the Claude app's Code tab needs, and keeps the plugin to its own Bluetooth channel, so ChatGPT and Claude Code share the pad by channel. - Doppel shows everything it will change and only goes ahead once you confirm. - A ChatGPT instance and Claude Code can no longer be given the same channel, and `doppel micro channel` now lists Claude Code too.
